svg.title: HospitalCare system architecture
svg.desc: Clean Architecture diagram of the HospitalCare API: client, error handler, JWT and roles, controllers, MediatR handlers, domain services, payment adapter, UnitOfWork, DbContext and SQL Server. Implemented parts are green, partial parts are amber.
svg.text: Clean Architecture · CQRS with MediatR · ASP.NET Core · EF Core · SQL Server

g.text: Bearer auth · 4 roles · login rate limit · account lockout
Paymob Adapter is complete in code and was checked by creating a test Intention; no payment was completed yet. Fake is the default provider.
NoShowProcessor and its domain rules exist; the check-in conditions used by call-next and no-show detection still need to be aligned.
